prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
(none yet)

(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 85.7%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 81.7%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 69.4%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 84.2%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 68.9%, median 395s / mean 5815s

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, hint] Account Auto-Sync Safety Microcopy: Display explicit microcopy on the sign-in screen assuring users that logging in saves their custom pet profile safely in the cloud. (why: Support received 8 emails (the largest complaint category) regarding pets missing or resetting after signing in again.)
1: [home, wait_info] Background Generation Task Status Checklist: Display a structured task completion checklist showing render stage progress while waiting for pet launch. (why: Home waiting duration has a mean of 2336s; explicit visual status updates reduce user frustration and perceived waiting time.)
2: [choose_path, layout] Split-Screen Companion Path Comparison Layout: Change choose_path layout to a split presentation clearly contrasting ready-made presets against full custom AI pet generation. (why: Choose_path has a high mean time of 514s despite 8s median, showing some users get stuck weighing options.)
3: [finish, notification] Desktop Tray Companion Launch Reminder: Add an explicit system tray notification alert on home_intro guiding users on where to find the pet icon if minimized. (why: Support received 3 emails about pets not showing up on desktop or app failing to open upon onboarding completion.)
4: [choose_path, hint] Welcome Story Screen Quick Overview Hint: Add a subtle tip component to the story screen explaining desktop companion features before path selection. (why: Path selection drop-off and high mean duration (514s) stem from unclear expectations on initial launch.)

scores.note: Strong evidence from 8 support emails addressing cloud sync fears at sign-in.
High mean wait time (2336s) at home step suggests progress feedback will reduce abandonments.
Helps users stuck on option comparison, though choose_path overall drop-off is relatively low.
Target step finish drops 31.1% and support mails report app visibility issues upon launch.
Low cost hint component to set early feature expectations on path selection.
